image_asset.title: Place Value Systems & Shortcut Factor Scaling Diagram

hotspots.label: Indian Place Value System
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Lakh = 10^5, Crore = 10^7. Commas placed after 3 digits from right, then every 2 digits.

hotspots.label: International Place Value System
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Million = 10^6, Billion = 10^9. Commas placed every 3 digits. 1 Crore = 10 Millions.

hotspots.label: Factor Shortcuts (x5 and x25)
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: N * 5 = (N / 2) * 10. N * 25 = (N / 4) * 100. Halve and scale by 10, or quarter and scale by 100.

hotspots.label: Sequential Digit Position Analytics
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Digits 1-9 take 9 positions; 10-99 take 180 positions. Finding position 100 yields digit 5.

video_overview.title: Journey of Scale
video_overview.topics_covered: Large numbers, lakhs, crores, millions, billions, place value systems, multiplication shortcuts, and digit position analytics.

image_asset.title: Term Partitioning, Laws & Zero-Pair Token Model Diagram

hotspots.label: Term Partitioning & Order
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Addition and subtraction signs partition expressions into individual terms evaluated before summation.

hotspots.label: Algebraic Laws of Arithmetic
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Commutative: a+b=b+a. Associative: (a+b)+c=a+(b+c). Distributive: a*(b+c)=ab+ac.

hotspots.label: Zero-Pair Token Model
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Subtracting b is adding its additive inverse: a-b = a+(-b). 18 blue (+1) + 10 red (-1) = 8 blue.

hotspots.label: Bracket Negation Rules
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Negating a bracket flips internal signs: -(a+b) = -a-b and -(a-b) = -a+b.

video_overview.title: Decoding Math Expressions
video_overview.topics_covered: Arithmetic expressions, order of operations, brackets, commutative, associative, and distributive laws, and additive inverses.

image_asset.title: Decimals Sub-Unit Measurement & Equivalent Grid Diagram

hotspots.label: Millimeter Subdivisions
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: 1 cm = 10 mm => 1 mm = 0.1 cm. Sub-unit subdivisions allow measuring exact fractional lengths.

hotspots.label: Expanded Decimal Grid
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Place values right of decimal: Tenths (0.1), Hundredths (0.01), Thousandths (0.001).

hotspots.label: Equivalent Decimals & Alignment
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Trailing zeros do not alter value: 0.2 = 0.20 = 0.200. Always align decimal points vertically.

video_overview.title: Magic of Decimals
video_overview.topics_covered: Decimals, tenths, hundredths, thousandths, sub-unit ruler measurements, currency/length unit conversions, and vertical alignment.

image_asset.title: Variables, Matchstick Patterns & Matrix Coordinates Diagram

hotspots.label: Polygon Perimeters
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Equilateral Triangle = 3s, Square = 4s, Regular Pentagon = 5s, Regular Hexagon = 6s.

hotspots.label: Matchstick Square Rule
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Building w connected squares requires 3w + 1 matchsticks (1st square takes 4, each added takes 3).

hotspots.label: Endless 4-Column Grid Formula
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Number N in row r, col c: N = 4(r - 1) + c = 4r - 4 + c. 143 lies in Row 36, Column 3.

hotspots.label: Combining Like Terms
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Like terms share identical variables: 5y + 2y = 7y. Unlike terms (3x + 4y) cannot be merged.

video_overview.title: Secret Code of Algebra
video_overview.topics_covered: Variables (letter-numbers), algebraic expressions, polygon perimeters, matchstick patterns, and endless 4-column grid formula.

image_asset.title: Intersecting Lines, Parallel Lines & Crease Geometry Diagram

hotspots.label: Intersecting Lines & Angles
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Vertically opposite angles are equal (∠a = ∠c). Linear pairs sum to 180° (∠a + ∠b = 180°).

hotspots.label: Parallel Lines (l || m)
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Coplanar lines that never meet. Maintain constant perpendicular distance throughout.

hotspots.label: Perpendicular Lines (l ⊥ m)
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Lines that intersect at right angles (90°), forming 4 orthogonal quadrants.

hotspots.label: Paper Folding Creases
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Successive horizontal folds yield parallel line creases; orthogonal fold creates perpendicular crease.

video_overview.title: Logic of Geometry
video_overview.topics_covered: Intersecting lines, vertically opposite angles, linear pairs, parallel lines, perpendicular lines, and paper folding crease geometry.

image_asset.title: Height Line Logic, Integer Parity & 3x3 Magic Square Diagram

hotspots.label: Height Line Logic
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Callout number = count of taller individuals standing ahead. Tallest person calls out 0.

hotspots.label: Integer Parity Algebra
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Even = 2n, Odd = 2n-1. Odd + Odd = Even. Loose leaf page sum = (2k-1)+2k = 4k-1 (Always ODD).

hotspots.label: 3x3 Magic Square Proof
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Magic constant S = 15. Center cell x belongs to 4 lines: 45 + 3x = 60 => x = 5. Exactly 8 rotations.

hotspots.label: Cryptarithms & Elimination
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Letter substitution puzzles solved using place-value digit constraints and parity elimination.

video_overview.title: Number Play: Hidden Math
video_overview.topics_covered: Height line callouts, integer parity (even/odd), loose leaf page sum rule, 3x3 magic squares, and cryptarithms.

image_asset.title: Direct Path vs Detour & Triangle Inequality Diagram

hotspots.label: Direct Path vs Detour
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Direct straight path c is strictly shorter than detour path a + b (c < a + b => a + b > c).

hotspots.label: Triangle Inequality Theorem
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Sum of any 2 sides > 3rd side (a+b>c, b+c>a, c+a>b). Test: Smallest two sum > longest side.

hotspots.label: Side-Based Classification
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Equilateral (a=b=c, always valid for s>0), Isosceles (a=b!=c), Scalene (a!=b!=c).

hotspots.label: Compass Arc Construction
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Compass arcs of radii a and b intersect to locate 3rd vertex iff a + b > c. Arcs fail if a + b <= c.

video_overview.title: Impossible Triangles
video_overview.topics_covered: Triangle formation, Triangle Inequality Theorem, compass and ruler constructions, and side-based triangle classification.

image_asset.title: Brahmagupta Area Model & Telescoping Series Diagram

hotspots.label: Brahmagupta's Rule (628 CE)
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: (a/b) * (c/d) = (a*c)/(b*d). Multiply numerators together and denominators together. Area model overlap.

hotspots.label: Reciprocal Division & Scaling
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: (a/b) / (c/d) = (a/b) * (d/c). Dividing by proper fraction (<1) ENLARGES the quotient value.

hotspots.label: Real-World Fraction Scaling
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Lace bags: 8 m / (1/4 m) = 32 bags. Tank fill time: 1 / (7/10) = 10/7 hours = 1 3/7 hrs.

video_overview.title: Fractions & Ancient India
video_overview.topics_covered: Fraction multiplication, Brahmagupta's rule (628 CE), area grid models, reciprocal division, and telescoping series.
